perfect_skip.perfect_drawing: the exact signed distance d of the drawing (REPO/train/glyphs.py signed_distance, the teacher's pen) at the library's own sample points, as coverage clip(0.5 + d * W * S, 0, 1), S = 2 below 24 pixels wide and 1 from there for automatic sampling, S = 1 for the one-sample rules; measured by the same metric code against the same teacher masks
perfect_skip.applies_to: both kinds; every counted size; automatic and one-sample rules
perfect_skip.skipped_when: the perfect drawing of the group misses the rule's limit at that size: mae, p99, firm, iou_mean for the group; glyph_mae (and glyph_iou where a gates file has it) for the one character
perfect_skip.recorded: verdict.json lists every skip per group ("skipped") with the perfect value and the limit, and any perfect drawing that fails nearest or vanished ("drawing_problems")

selection: a group ships when seed 0 and seed 1 both pass the common gates (gates-v2.2.json), the seed with the lower mean of the mean error at 8x16, 16x32 and 48x96; a group that fails is trained once more as two groups of half its characters; a half that still fails is left out and its characters stay untrained. Under gates-v2.2 a rule that the perfect drawing of a group itself fails at a size is not applied there
scoring: gates_v2.py score --kind letters --gates gates-v2.2.json, against the teacher of every character drawn for the bundle
trainer: train/split_expert.py train --mode repertoire --partition contiguous, width 64, 120000 steps, seeds 0,1, teacher grid 256
